document.title: ESP32-WROVER-KIT_V4.1
document.extraction_method: manual visual extraction from rendered PDF page 1 plus parsed schematic text; hierarchical JSON optimized for LLM retrieval, not a native CAD netlist export
limitations: The schematic is a dense single-page PDF without a machine-readable CAD netlist; several unlabeled local transistor nets were assigned synthetic names.
D1 and U2 are compatible alternate ESP32 module footprints shown together. They should normally be treated as assembly alternatives, not as two simultaneously fitted modules.

0-ohm resistors are preserved as components and also listed in series_links. Do not automatically merge the two sides unless populated=true and the consuming workflow intentionally collapses 0R links.
Some LED/status and transistor B/C/E pin roles around FT2232 and auto-program logic are inferred from schematic symbols and labels, not from a CAD pin database.

References with suffixes such as R138_LCD or R48_CONN are disambiguation aliases where the PDF text/visual extraction showed duplicate reference usage or overlapping labels. The original visible reference is retained in the value/description context.

summary.llm_usage_hint: Use nets[].connections for component-to-net traversal; use signal_groups for higher-level peripheral mapping; use series_links to optionally collapse populated 0-ohm links.

functional_blocks.serial_port_usb_uart: Micro USB connector, FT2232HL USB bridge, EEPROM, crystal, status LEDs, FTDI GPIO/test points.
functional_blocks.esp32_module: ESP32 module alternate footprints, ESP32 supply decoupling, EN/boot straps, 32 kHz crystal option, R_IO series resistor bank.
functional_blocks.switch_autoprogram: BOOT/EN buttons and DTR/RTS auto-program transistor network.
functional_blocks.spi_jtag: 2x14 SPI/JTAG header and jumpers/pullups for JTAG use.
functional_blocks.lcd_screen: LCD connector, SPI signal links, backlight driver, decoupling.
functional_blocks.connector_io_expand: 2x14 I/O expansion header with series links and optional pullups.
functional_blocks.camera: 2x9 camera header mapping ESP32 GPIOs to camera signals.
functional_blocks.sd_card: TF card socket, pullups, ESD array, series links.
functional_blocks.rgb: Common-anode RGB LED with three MOSFET low-side drivers.
functional_blocks.power: External/USB 5 V selection and 3.3 V regulator.

assembly_options.name: ESP32 module footprint selection
assembly_options.note: Schematic note: Support ESP32 Module, compatible old and new module.

assembly_options.name: 32 kHz crystal vs GPIO32/GPIO33
assembly_options.note: The schematic note states 32K-CLK mode and GPIO mode are selected by 0R population options. Preserve the resistor population state before collapsing nets.

assembly_options.name: JTAG usage
assembly_options.note: Schematic note near JP2: When you use JTAG, please put jumpers ON.

assembly_options.name: External power
assembly_options.note: Schematic note indicates USB power may be insufficient when using LCD/camera/etc.; J2 reserves external 5 V power input.

derived_relationships.net_collapse_recommendation: For firmware/peripheral mapping, collapse populated 0R series_links. For PCB/electrical analysis, keep both sides and model each 0R resistor explicitly.
